---
name: ingest-paper-batch
description: Ingest a selected batch of papers in independent Copilot CLI sessions, then compare and link the published wiki pages in a fresh session.
---

# Ingest and compare a batch of papers

Before launching any session, check the selected papers against canonical wiki frontmatter. Match by ID, canonical path, source URL, or normalized exact title. Resolve alternate references to the same work during selection when possible. Report and skip existing papers: do not run ingestion or include them in synthesis unless the user explicitly named them as comparison targets. Do not silently select replacements. If all selected papers are already in the wiki, stop without launching any sessions.

1. **Select the papers.** Accept paper titles, IDs, URLs, wiki paths, an inline list, or a path to a paper list such as a ranked shortlist. Apply any filters, limits, exclusions, or ranking instructions before launching sessions. For example, `top 3, skip the seed` selects the first three eligible ranked entries, not the seed, references in their notes, or the coverage section. Preserve the requested order (otherwise use list order). Resolve ambiguous names and aliases to verified identifiers rather than guessing; prefer stable IDs or primary-source URLs and remove duplicates. Ask only if the selection cannot be determined. Include explicit comparison targets (such as the shortlist seed) as existing canonical wiki IDs, not as papers to ingest unless selected. Keep constraints for writing or comparison separate from selection constraints.
2. **Run the independent sessions.** From the repository root, run `python3 -m harness.ingest_paper_batch <paper> [<paper> ...]`, passing one selected title, ID, URL, or path per argument. Pass `--ingest-constraints` and `--synthesis-constraints` only for applicable instructions, and repeat `--compare-with <wiki-id>` for existing comparison targets. The runner starts a fresh `copilot --prompt` process for each paper, with no inherited conversation or other batch papers. Each process loads [ingest-paper](../ingest-paper/SKILL.md). Wait for the process to finish before starting the next one so writes to `wiki/index.md` do not overlap. If the user asks for draft-only work or review before publishing, do not use the publishing runner; use separate interactive sessions and defer synthesis until the approved pages are published.
3. **Run synthesis only after all pending papers are ready.** The runner checks each newly published canonical page and index entry and validates the wiki before launching one more fresh CLI process with the new paper IDs and any explicit comparison targets. That session follows the [synthesis prompt](prompts/synthesize.md) to update differentiators and typed relationships from source evidence, not from prior conversations. It validates the wiki again. If a paper is blocked or fails verification, finish the other ingestions, report the failure, and do not synthesize a partial batch.

`/new` is an interactive command; the runner uses fresh CLI processes for the same context isolation. It does not enable broad tool permissions. Use the user's approved non-interactive permissions, or pass explicitly authorized `--allow-tool`, `--allow-url`, or `--assisted-approval` options. If sign-in, trust, permissions, or review require interaction, use literal `/new`, then `/ingest-paper <paper>` for each pending paper. After all approved pages are present and validated, use `/new` once more and give that session the new canonical IDs, explicit comparison targets, and synthesis prompt. Report published and skipped IDs, synthesis edits, and any blockers.
